title: Female Warrior with Hammer
description: A confident young woman with long dark hair in a topknot stands in a dynamic pose, smiling at the viewer. She wears orange and purple tribal-style armor, holds a massive purple warhammer with both hands, and has visible tattoos on her arms and torso.
